upstreamShift.summary: Two coordinated feature edges land in this seam over BASE..NEW: (1) an Agent-identity refactor that changes the scoped-waterfall contract in src/index.ts to require request.agent (rejects mismatched or absent agent) instead of deriving Context via carrierKeyOf(this) + Reflect.get; (2) two additive extensions — a new sessionFeedbackRemote mount in src/client/index.ts (from dsh-command-feedback) and a new goal/activation-changed emit entry in src/remote-events.ts. Version bumps 0.1.3-alpha.2 → 0.1.5-rc.2. tsconfig.host.json gains goal/goal reference (feeding the new dsh-goal/types import in src/index.ts). tsconfig.client.json gains feedback/command-feedback ref. Tests grow (remote-events.host.spec.ts) to cover the new goal event and the 'must carry its Agent directly' error path with id: 'agent-1' shape. README.md + README.zh.md + README.i18n.yaml receive substantive polish clarifying the request.agent contract and the waterfall-replay-only-on-reconnect wording. Underlying commits: ebce3a5f04 refactor(agent) — the identity contract change; f2f9700de2 feat(feedback) — sessionFeedbackRemote wire; e26fc35d4b fix(goal) + upstream Goal work — the activation-changed event. Merges/release bumps (a305303422, 1ef9c1fa9a, dd393c1820, 2faa751be9, 59f2e3be33) drive version churn.
keyRefactors: src/index.ts remoteEventSource: scoped waterfall now requires request.agent === carrierKeyOf(this); dispatch context shape becomes { value: agent.ctx, subject: agent, agentId: agent.id } instead of { value, subject }. Fork does not touch this function — clean overlay expected.
src/index.ts imports: new `import type { Agent } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent'` + new `import type {} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-goal/types'` in the type-only reflection block.
src/client/index.ts: sessionFeedbackRemote from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-feedback/remote' added to imports, mount list, and type re-exports.

breakingChanges: Scoped waterfall contract change: any Client that emits a scoped-waterfall Remote event without setting `request.agent` (matching the routed carrier) will now throw TypeError('...must carry its Agent directly'). Fork's dsh-schema-gateway/dsh-evidence-query/dsh-result-cache waterfalls (if any) must be audited for this shape.

Dispatch payload shape change: TypertRemoteEventInvocation['context'] now includes `agentId: agent.id`; downstream consumers reading the third field of `context` see an extra key. Test harness fixtures in fork's tests/evidence-query-remote.client.spec.ts must construct agents with an `id` property.

conflictSeverity.rationale: All collisions are additive-additive or upstream-refactor-in-clean-zone; no semantic contradiction. The medium rating is driven by: (a) src/client/index.ts has 4 hunks where upstream inserts one mount/import and fork inserts three-in-different-places on the same-line spans, requiring careful union — but the semantics are clean (both sides just want more contributions in the array); (b) package.json has version-bump + end-of-list-append conflict where BOTH sides appended after zod, requiring the merger to keep upstream's 0.1.5-rc.2 version + both sides' dep sets; (c) the Agent-identity refactor in src/index.ts (upstream-only) may impose a contract on fork's evidence-query/schema-gateway/result-cache scoped waterfalls: if those emitters currently invoke waterfalls without `request.agent`, upstream's new TypeError will bite the first time an Agent-scoped call hits them. Audit needed but likely a non-issue since ordinary emit contributions bypass the check. Once seam-2 (which owns Agent-shape decisions in the emitter packages) is settled, seam-5 is a mechanical union merge plus 3 test-hotspot regressions to confirm.

recommendedApproach: three-way-manual (dominant strategy) with a strong fork-preserves-additive-only overlay. Concrete plan: (1) For src/index.ts, README.md, README.zh.md, README.i18n.yaml, tests/remote-events.host.spec.ts — take upstream wholesale (fork unmodified). (2) For src/client/index.ts, src/remote-events.ts, tsconfig.host.json, tsconfig.client.json — union merge additive entries (all 4 upstream entries + all fork entries must survive). (3) For package.json — take upstream version bump (0.1.5-rc.2) + union of devDependencies + verify dsh-session correctly appears in devDependencies (fork's move from deps). (4) For src/types.ts, tests/built-lib.e2e.ts, tests/evidence-query-remote.client.spec.ts — keep fork wholesale (upstream untouched). (5) Post-merge audit: grep fork's emitter packages (schema-gateway, evidence-query, result-cache) for scoped-waterfall listeners; confirm each emit path attaches `request.agent` before ctx.emit or that they only use ordinary emit mode. Runbook: settle seam-2 (remote-api emitter changes) FIRST, then seam-5 as its consumer downstream."
